caseName: Kansas Gas & Electric Co. v. State Corp. Commission
caseNameFull: Kansas Gas & Electric Co. v. State Corporation Commission of Kansas and Kansas City Power & Light Co. v. State Corporation Commission of Kansas

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Ct. Kan. Motion of Edison Electric Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these cases.

Reported below: 239 Kan. 483, 720 P. 2d 1063.
